subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Should this issue require one shared scheme-aware Telegram/Undici proxy repair across explicit and environment SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS routes before closure?
rationale: The source-level bug is plausible, but the open candidate PR changes a compatibility-sensitive shared proxy helper and maintainers need to decide the supported proxy contract and proof bar.

options.title: Require shared proxy repair
options.body: Keep this issue open until a patch covers explicit and env SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS routes, preserves HTTP proxy endpoint defaults, and supplies redacted live Telegram proxy proof.

options.title: Accept explicit-only scope
options.body: Allow PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84582 or similar to address only explicit proxy mode, while tracking env proxy and HTTP default compatibility separately.

options.title: Close for insufficient live repro
options.body: Close this issue until a reporter provides a current-main SOCKS5 Telegram getMe/sendMessage reproduction, accepting that the source-level gap remains unowned.

recommendation.title: Require shared proxy repair
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a patch covers explicit and env SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS routes, preserves HTTP proxy endpoint defaults, and supplies redacted live Telegram proxy proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the shared Undici proxy helper and recent Telegram proxy/fallback work that define the repair boundary.
